description: This file defines extension methods for the EventData class from Azure.Messaging.EventHubs, adding functionality to set and get stream namespace properties, as well as serialize and deserialize event data properties.

classes.name: EventDataExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for EventData to support streaming functionalities such as setting/getting stream namespace and serializing/deserializing properties.

methods.name: SetStreamNamespaceProperty
methods.description: Adds or updates the stream namespace property in EventData.Properties.

methods.name: GetStreamNamespaceProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the stream namespace property from EventData.Properties, returning null if not present.

methods.name: SerializeProperties
methods.description: Serializes the EventData.Properties dictionary, excluding the stream namespace key, into a byte array using the provided serializer.

methods.name: DeserializeProperties
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into a dictionary of properties using the provided serializer.
